inputs: Fork directions canvas: direction 1, Offprint (chosen), with Night edition's fork divider
fork.netadao.org copy: index, about, scope, cfp, submit, statement
Fork's cut wordmark and its motion, from the Neta DAO Academy system (ForkMark)

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground on every page: a light grey stock, neutral with the faintest warmth, Fork's own colour (the Academy's Fork panel takes it on hover). Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The one raised surface: a field's fill and the submit box at the end of a reading page. A lighter grey, bordered by `rule`, never shadowed.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, display type, the strip's and footer's rules, the 1px rules that open a list, solid buttons and the Fork mark: near-black. 15.7:1 on `paper`, 17.3:1 on `sheet`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary reading copy, contributor names, metadata values in mono, captions: a dark warm grey. 7.4:1 on `paper`, 8.2:1 on `sheet`. Never for titles.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only (a field's border is `ink`), so it may sit under 3:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: issue
tokens.usage: The current volume's colour (Vol. 0: magenta). Its cover, kickers, numerals, the pull quote, the underline of links in prose and one branch of the fork divider. 5.1:1 on `paper`, 5.6:1 on `sheet`, and `on-issue` reads on it at 5.1:1. A new volume sets its own (README, Issues), never two on one page.

tokens.name: on-issue
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an `issue` fill: the cover's numeral, theme and dates.

tokens.name: issue-tint
tokens.usage: `issue` at about 12% on `paper`: text selection and the flash on a note you jumped to. Never a fill for a block.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 3px. On an `issue` fill the ring is `on-issue`. 3:1 or more on every ground.

families.text: Newsreader, "Newsreader Ext", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: cover-numeral
styles.usage: The volume number on an IssueCover; scales down with the cover (20vw, 180–280px).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: The Event of Web3 and the Question Concerning Technology
styles.usage: The homepage's lead title. clamp(44px, 5.4vw, 76px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: A page or article title. clamp(42px, 5.2vw, 72px).

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Italic. The principles line and nothing else. clamp(44px, 5vw, 68px).

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Scope areas and the About page's numbered sections, in `issue`.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Fork publishes theoretical and critical work on the politics of decentralized systems.
styles.usage: The opening sentence of a page or section. clamp(24px, 2.3vw, 30px).

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: The Journal of Interchain Theory and Politics
styles.usage: Italic. The journal's subtitle beside the mark; a CFP's question under its title (24px).

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: from memoir to manifesto, from whitepaper to speculation
styles.usage: Italic, in `issue`. The PullQuote. clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 34px).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A section of a reading page, after its § number.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: A scope area, an About section, the submit box.

styles.name: entry
styles.usage: A title in a contents list.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A fork is the moment when a shared history diverges and two possible futures emerge.
styles.usage: Reading copy: articles, the call, About. Stops at `measure`.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: We take blockchain seriously as a site of political and intellectual contestation.
styles.usage: Page copy outside a reading column, facts' values, list items, fields.

styles.name: text-s
styles.sample: On-chain and off-chain governance mechanisms, DAO constitutions, voting systems.
styles.usage: Scope descriptions, contributor names (italic, `ink-2`).

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Notes and references, figure captions.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: VOL. 0 · INAUGURAL ISSUE · CALL FOR PAPERS
styles.usage: Uppercase by CSS. Kickers, navigation, section labels.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Uppercase by CSS. Buttons and arrow links.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Uppercase by CSS. A fact's term, an entry's type, a specimen's caption.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Numbers in contents and § marks, in `issue`.

styles.name: smallprint
styles.sample: © Neta DAO Academy. Open access. No rights reserved.
styles.usage: The footer's last line.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: A label's gap to its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a fact; between nav items' rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons; a list row's padding with `space-4`.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding in contents and facts; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs of reading copy (with the 1.62 leading).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a kicker, a title and its lede.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between grid items (scope areas) and inside the cover.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a label column and its content on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: The desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a page's label column and its content; between hero columns.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: A section's vertical padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything. Offprint is square: buttons, fields, the cover, the submit box.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: The page's content width; header, main and footer all centre on it.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The reading column's maximum width (about 65 characters of `body`).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every page band.

tokens.name: section-pad
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a homepage section.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule: `rule` between rows, `ink` above a list and around the nav.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Two places only: above the masthead and above the footer, in `ink`.

tokens.name: stroke-divider
tokens.usage: The fork divider's three lines.
